item.title: 20 Years Later, A Classic Nintendo DS Puzzle Game Officially Returns
item.description: Next year will mark the 20th anniversary of Level-5's beloved Professor Layton series. To celebrate, the company has announced it is remaking Professor Layton and the Curious Village .

item.title: HBO’s 5-Part Crime Drama Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
item.description: At the turn of the 21st century, HBO was the place for prestige crime drama. The launch of The Sopranos in 1999 paved the way for the 2002 premiere of The Wire , which focused on drug dealers in Baltimore and the police officers trying to disrupt their operations. The series is still one of the best shows of all time, and provided breakout roles for huge stars like Idris Elba and Michael B. Jordan . But while it was compelling from the beginning, The Wire truly achieved perfection in season 4 when the scope expanded beyond the drug trade to examine the cycle of institutional failure.

item.title: Fallout 5 and Fallout Remasters Officially Announced
item.description: Xbox wants more Fallout, and after a yearslong drought of new games, Bethesda Softworks is making it happen. Bethesda plans to release remasters of both Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas for modern platforms, the company said in July in a massive roadmap of the developer's future. Those remasters are part of a larger plan to reinvest in Fallout games — including Fallout 5 , which is currently in pre-production — and a new untitled project at Obsidian Entertainment.

item.title: Blizzard Officially Responds to Disappointed Overwatch Fans Over Hero 55
item.description: Blizzard Entertainment is about to make good on the promise of delivering 10 new heroes to Overwatch in 2026, with the final addition arriving in December. The 10th new hero coming to Overwatch in 2026 is an Omnic detective named Hudson, and he'll arrive alongside the launch of season 6. Hudson was officially revealed on Thursday, but many Overwatch fans aren't pleased with a key aspect of his character.

item.title: 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO Max (November 13 - 15)
item.description: Happy weekend! Several movies are hitting theaters this week, from the action-comedy How to Rob a Bank , starring Nicholas Hoult, Zoë Kravitz, and Christian Slater, to Ti West’s take on A Christmas Carol , titled Ebenezer and starring Johnny Depp.

item.title: 6 Most-Anticipated Steam Games You Should Add to Your Wishlist Right Now
item.description: Sometimes when we put together a new installment of Wishlister , Polygon’s weekly newsletter that highlights upcoming Steam games, we look to events like Steam Next Fest and the Triple-I Initiative to dig up gems. But the most tried-and-true method we’ve found for finding promising games is simply stumbling into them by accident.

item.title: Marvel Officially Confirms New Avengers Team for Doomsday
item.description: The Marvel Cinematic Universe 's Avengers lineup has been a bit muddled since the events of Captain America: Civil War , which broke up the team of besties. Things got more confusing when the team of misfits in last year's Thunderbolts* was declared the New Avengers at the end of the film, causing a bit of a kerfuffle between the team and Anthony Mackie's Sam Wilson/Captain America over who gets to call themselves Avengers.

item.title: Cities: Skylines' Best Replacement Is Finally Here and Better than Expected
item.description: 2026 is the year I got massively into city builders, and by massively I mean I played Cities: Skylines more than anything else for the first half of the year. I started dabbling with city builder-slash-logistics games in the second half of the year, like Anno 117 , and turned my attention to Transport Fever 3 soon after. When I first learned about Transport Fever 3 , I called it "like" Cities: Skylines . It looked a lot like a traditional city builder, albeit one where you focus on roads more than zoning. After playing it over the last month or so, though, I realize the difference between city builder and logistics planner is a lot more distinct than I initially gave it credit for — and I've irreversibly become a logistics sicko.

item.title: 8 New TV Shows to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO (November 13-15)
item.description: It’s a big weekend for new TV. VisionQuest has concluded its first season, including a post-credits scene with big implications for Avengers: Doomsday . The Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power is back with a third season, continuing the story of a Middle-earth set thousands of years before Bilbo and Frodo Baggins. The Body is also available on Netflix, delivering a fun and campy high school drama with some religious horror thrown in the mix.

item.title: Blood of Dawnwalker Finally Gets Its Most Requested Feature Next Week
item.description: It's been just over two months since The Blood of Dawnwalker was released and fans have been clamoring for one missing feature for basically that long. Now developer Rebel Wolves is set to appease that demand with the upcoming update 1.2. Yes, New Game Plus is going to be a reality for the vampire RPG.
